scope: 10 BanG Dream! and 10 Love Live! representative recent or announced event-card candidates; not a claim of the chronologically latest twenty productions.

rules: Search snippets are discovery/partial evidence, not a stable production API.
Never infer official non-publication from fetch failure.
Never infer ticket inventory merely from an application window.
Do not infer an actual seating plan from a generic venue diagram.
Store source-publication time separately from fetch time.
Preserve semantic query parameters, including p and _id.
Do not inherit per-performance fields unless shared applicability is explicit.
